facts.fact: ANP reports that on 18 July 2025 the Minister of Communication installed a committee to review the "projet de document" of the PNDN 2026-2035, with one month to update its data, take in the government's new objectives and draw up an implementation plan; the policy is described as awaited, with no adopting act or body named.

systems.tiers: Described by the minister as a framework document for the digital sector meant to speed digitalisation of public services, strengthen cybersecurity, innovation and skills, improve the legal and institutional framework and build the digital economy, in line with the Programme de Résilience pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie.
